formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 5, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 120) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 7
plain_statement: SEARCH GAP, possibly false: exhibit a linear space L of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension exactly 7 on which the sum, over all injections f of the 4 rows into the 5 columns, of the product of (1 + t(i, f(i))) stays equal to 120 (its value at t = 0). That condition is the same as all sums of k x k subpermanents of t vanishing on L. Dimension 6 is attained by a row plus a column; no space of dimension 7 is known and none is excluded; the conjectured bound p + q - 2 = 7 allows it. A witness would be an explicit basis; a refutation would be the bound 6.
title: Search: a level space of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension 7 (one above the hook)
